introduction: Utah unemployment requires an initial online claim and separate weekly filings. File eligible weeks while a decision is pending rather than waiting for an award.
description: Utah unemployment requires an initial online claim and separate weekly filings. File eligible weeks while a decision is pending rather than waiting for an award.

sections.who: DWS reviews qualifying wages, separation and ongoing ability, availability and work-search conditions.
sections.get: Temporary wage-replacement payments for eligible claimed weeks.
sections.docs:
• Employment and wage history.
  • Separation details.
  • Weekly work, earnings and job-search records.
sections.apply:
1. File online

    Use my Unemployment.

  2. Read claim notices

    Check wage and eligibility decisions and respond to requests.

  3. File each week

    Use File Weekly Claim and answer every reporting question accurately.
sections.after: Keep filing while awaiting a decision and follow reporting and work-search instructions. Use CARE Live Chat for trouble filing online.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Current claimant guide, Online claim service. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Can I start the claim by telephone?
The current claimant guide says claims are not taken by phone and directs online filing.
Should I wait for approval to file weeks?
No. The guide instructs weekly filing while a decision is pending.
Is a wage determination approval for every week?
Ongoing eligibility is also assessed; read the separate notices and weekly questions.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
